evidence_boundary: Independent-study, same-endpoint retrospective external evaluation. Leppek labels were historically inspected; this is not a blind test or prospective confirmation.

source.endpoint: Measured polysome-fraction-derived mean ribosome load (MRL), on the author-reported scale without recalibration

construct_inclusion.requirements: Unique nonmissing Sequence ID; nonmissing uppercase ACGT-only 5'UTR of length >=4; finite Ribosome load
construct_inclusion.deduplication: None: every eligible construct remains in the fixed pool; exact 5'UTR defines its biological cluster
construct_inclusion.below_minimum_action: STOP before prediction-label metrics and preserve evidence

sample_exclusion.exact: Exclude the entire exact-UTR cluster if its sequence occurs in any role
sample_exclusion.hamming1: For equal-length sequences only, exclude the entire exact-UTR cluster if Hamming distance 1 occurs against any role; unequal lengths are not Hamming-1 matches
sample_exclusion.conflict_policy: One conflict excludes all constructs sharing that full UTR; no row-wise rescue and no subset tuning

model.architecture: Frozen 4-mer MLP ensemble; 256 normalized 4-mer counts plus GC fraction, binary uAUG and longest_poly_u/50; Linear(259,32)-ReLU-Linear(32,1)
model.training: Forbidden; use existing frozen weights and training scalers only
model.input: Native variable-length full 5'UTR; no 50nt CNN, no truncation, no N-padding, no sequence alteration
model.aggregation: Unweighted arithmetic mean of three member predictions on the original MRL scale

cuda.cpu_fallback: Forbidden; assert model parameters, inputs and outputs are CUDA and record GPU identity

primary.fixed_pool: All eligible constructs after frozen Sample exclusion
primary.proposal: For each seed, PCG64 permutation of construct-row indices; Random selects index 0; BoN selects the maximum frozen proxy mean among the first cap=16 nested proposal rows
primary.ties: Lexicographically smallest Sequence ID, then lowest row position
primary.oracle: Maximum measured Ribosome load in the same fixed/resampled pool with the same tie rule
primary.regret: Oracle measured MRL minus selected measured MRL; nonnegative
primary.effect: BoN-minus-Random realized-MRL regret for the same seed; negative favors BoN
primary.estimand: Arithmetic mean paired effect over all 200 algorithm seeds
primary.significance: Two-sided bootstrap sign p=2*min((#delta>=0+1)/10001,(#delta<=0+1)/10001), capped at 1; significant only if the 95% percentile CI is entirely below zero and p<0.05; no directional or subset rewrite

bootstrap.unit: Exact full 5'UTR cluster; resample clusters with replacement and carry all their construct rows
bootstrap.rebuild: Rebuild Random/BoN proposals and measured-MRL oracle in every resample; duplicate cluster copies remain distinct rows
bootstrap.interval: Percentile [2.5,97.5] of 10000 replicate mean paired effects

construct_level_metrics: MAE on the unrecalibrated same-endpoint MRL scale
secondary.uncertainty: Same UTR-cluster resamples; recompute each metric on resampled constructs
secondary.independence: Algorithm seeds are repeated stochastic proposals, not independent biological replicates; inference uses UTR clusters

validation.round1: Raw hashes, construct/exclusion audit, tests, actual CUDA inference, frozen statistical execution
validation.round2: Independently written XLSX/feature/CUDA/statistical recomputation including all 10000 bootstrap replicates
validation.round3: Delivery hash and report-number verification after local synchronization
validation.negative_results: Retain null and unfavorable results; no outer tuning, subset changes or protocol edits after metrics
